validity.recommendation: Reclassify PipelineType from 'transmission' to a lateral/distribution designation (or flag as a feeder/lateral cluster); sources uniformly describe Package 13 as lateral pipelines distributing gas within the Riyadh cluster, not a trunk transmission line.
validity.researcher_notes:
EXISTENCE: confirmed real and well-corroborated. P6733 maps cleanly to MGS-3 (Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3) Package 13. MEED ('Aramco selects contractors for Master Gas System expansion') states verbatim: Package 13 = 'Laying 16-inch, 12-inch, 10-inch and 4-inch lateral pipelines in the Riyadh cluster, covering 470km.' This independently matches the GEM row exactly (segment=Riyadh, length=470 km, diameters 12,16,10,4 in). Blackridge Research's MGS-3 project profile independently confirms the same Package 13 Riyadh cluster, 470 km, 16/12/10/4-inch lateral pipelines, plus program-level figures (4153 km total network, +3.2 bcf/d capacity, completion Q4 2028, owner Saudi Aramco). DMS Projects independently lists a dedicated 'Package 13 - Riyadh Cluster' under MGS-3 (detail gated behind login). Three independent origins (MEED trade press, Blackridge research profile, DMS Projects database) agree -> existence is high-confidence; not a GEM-only entity.

ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco (100%) confirmed by all sources (MGS = Aramco's Master Gas System). Country Saudi Arabia confirmed; province is Riyadh region (laterals within the Riyadh cluster). Fuel=Gas confirmed (Master Gas SYSTEM = sales/dry gas grid; the laterals branch off the 56-inch dry-gas trunk to feed power plants and industrial/household users). Status=construction confirmed (program under construction Q2 2024 onward, completion Q4 2028). StartYear1=2028 is consistent with the Q4 2028 program completion (in-service year).

CLASSIFICATION (the concern): GEM records PipelineType='transmission'. Every source that characterizes Package 13 calls these LATERAL pipelines. Blackridge explicitly states they 'function as distribution/secondary network infrastructure rather than trunk transmission... smaller-diameter laterals that branch into regional clusters... serving to distribute gas from main trunk lines to end-users and industrial facilities.' The small mixed diameters (4-16 in) are physically inconsistent with a 470 km trunk transmission line (the MGS-3 trunk lines are 56-inch, captured separately as P6717-P6731). So while the entity is real and the commodity (gas) is correct, the PipelineType is most defensibly a lateral/distribution classification, not 'transmission'. Flagged for human reclassification decision (GEM may by convention keep large gathering/lateral clusters as 'transmission'; deferring the final call).

SPEC: Length 470 km and diameters 12,16,10,4 in are both directly corroborated by MEED and Blackridge (2 independent origins) -> high. The worklist's prior diameter check failed only on string ordering ('12,16,10,4' vs source phrasing '16-inch, 12-inch, 10-inch and 4-inch'); the values themselves are present and correct. Capacity is blank in GEM and left blank: only a program-wide +3.2 bcf/d figure exists, which cannot be attributed to this single 470 km lateral package, so no number is forced.

DUPLICATE: Not a duplicate. P6733 is one of ~17 distinct MGS-3 packages all carrying the umbrella name 'MGS III Gas Pipelines' (P6717-P6737). It is the unique Riyadh-cluster lateral package (470 km, 4-16 in); the other rows are distinct east-west trunk segments (56 in) or other clusters. No other roster row shares the 470 km / Riyadh-lateral fingerprint.

fills.researcher_notes: Location [ref] was MISSING_REF. Both sources place Package 13's 470 km laterals in the 'Riyadh cluster' within Saudi Arabia; province set to Riyadh. Specific start/end point coordinates are not published (it is a multi-lateral cluster, not a single point-to-point line), so granular StartLocation/EndLocation left blank rather than fabricated. Province + country are the defensible, source-backed location fills.

summary: P6733 is real and well-corroborated as MGS-3 Package 13 (Riyadh cluster, 470 km, 4-16 in laterals, Aramco, gas, construction) but is MISCLASSIFIED as 'transmission' when all sources describe it as lateral/distribution pipelines; filled the missing Location ref (Riyadh, Saudi Arabia).
